soap.subjective: Male patient with 4 months of panic attacks (palpitations, dyspnea, diaphoresis), occurring 3-4 times per week. Avoidance behavior (highway driving). Precipitating stressor: job loss. Insomnia with ruminative worrying. Past anxiety in college, untreated. No suicidal ideation. No current medications.
soap.objective: Alert, oriented. Blood pressure 132/84. Heart rate 94. Thyroid non-tender, no goiter. GAD-7 score 16 (severe). PHQ-9 score 11 (moderate depression). TSH ordered to rule out thyroid etiology.

assessment.summary: Panic disorder with severe generalized anxiety (GAD-7 16) and comorbid moderate depression (PHQ-9 11). Situational precipitant (job loss). No medical cause identified pending TSH.

icd10_codes.description: Major depressive disorder, single episode, moderate

plan.instructions: Sertraline to increase to 100mg after 2 weeks if tolerated. CBT referral for panic disorder. Limit caffeine after noon. 30-minute daily exercise. Avoid alcohol. Lorazepam strictly short-term (max 4 weeks).
plan.follow_up: 4-week follow-up for medication response and to discontinue lorazepam
